name: Clipmap Voxel Storage with Mipmap Generation
definition: A voxel storage structure using clipmaps that generates mipmaps for inner clipmaps and the largest clipmap via compute shaders, copying regions between textures to handle axis-aligned downsampling.
summary: Clipmap Voxel Storage with Mipmap Generation optimizes memory locality for view-dependent rendering by organizing data into concentric rings and using explicit region copies for downsampling instead of recursive texture sampling.
